answer_1.quote: The description generation task calls for generating referring expressions describing people in a text.
answer_1.outputs: referring expressions describing people in a text

answer_2.quote: We measure precision of the generated description (𝑦 gen ) with the 𝑦 ref ∈ {𝑦 ⋆ , 𝑦 inc , 𝑦 nf } (after excluding stop words) using BLEU (unigram), ROUGE-L and Bertscore.

answer_4.quote: We ask crowdworkers on AMT (paid ∼US$15/hour on AMT) if they are familiar with the given entity.
answer_4.guideline: We ask crowdworkers on AMT... if they are familiar with the given entity. For the entities marked as familiar, we ask annotators to add a short description of the entity... We specifically ask the annotators to not use external search for this task... two attention check questions...
